source_text: Relativist arguments, often drawn from qualitative ethnographic studies rather than large-scale health outcomes, are faulted for prioritizing adult rationalizations over minors' incapacity to consent, with surveys in practicing communities revealing 70-90% of procedures coerced on girls aged 0-14.
